title: The wand
starting_code: # Walk to the stone, pick up the wand, and come back.
hints: Walk right to reach the stone, then use the method to pick things up.
After you pick it up, you need two more moves to walk back to me.
Use the `pick_up` method with empty brackets when you are right beside it.
intro: I left my spare wand on that flat stone in the corner over there. Walk over, pick it up, and come back to the path by me!
outro: You have a wand now! It is only lent, though: one day you will give it back to me.
learned: Now you know that things to carry are objects too, and how to pick them up.
